text:
Praveen: Heads-up — I drafted release notes for the batch + cache improvements and the new canary rollout UI for Dedicated. Need quick eyes on known issues and SDK snippets before tomorrow's ship.

Anna: Posted the draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/draft-batch-cache. Short read, highlights and examples at the bottom.

Jordan: Will review snippets. Which SDKs are in scope? Python + JS + Go?

Praveen: Yes. Python and JS are highest priority, Go if time. Small changes: streaming example needs to show `prefetch_kv=true` and how to set `batching: {"max_tokens": 1024}` in the request.

Emma: Quick note — there's a known issue on Private where prefix caching sometimes misses when customers pin model variants. We should add a "Known issues" bullet and an example workaround (`restart-worker` workaround).

Li: I can add the workaround and a brief migration blurb for Private (VPC) customers. Also, double-check link targets for the dedicated admin console screenshots; some anchors changed.

Anna: I'll run a linkcheck sweep after edits. If anyone moves anchors, ping me in-thread.

Jordan: Snippet patch for Python (draft):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=...)
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-optim", input="Summarize...", batching={"max_tokens":1024}, prefetch_kv=True)
print(resp.text)
```
I'll add a JS example mirroring this.

Emma: Docs-bot: please schedule a publish dry-run tomorrow 10:30am PT and run the snippet linter.

docs-bot: Scheduled: dry-run at 2026-03-24T17:30:00Z. Snippet linter queued.

Praveen: Good. Two final asks: (1) add an explicit callout about possible tokenization diffs with quantized models (off-by-one in a small % of cases) and mitigation steps, (2) a one-liner in the top-level blurb for product about improved per-route latency and cost-saving from KV caching.

Li: I'll add the quantization note and link to the eval PR.

Anna: After docs-bot linter results, can we aim to merge by EOD? If any blocker, tag me @Anna.

Praveen: Thanks all — I'll flip the draft to "ready for review" after Li's edits. :thumbsup:
